title: yodel test --json
description: Version 1. The cases of tests/*.test.ts, each run on a database built from the migrations on a throwaway server: what passed, what failed and why. Within a version, fields are only added; a reader ignores fields it does not know.

scope.description: The databases (ClickHouse) or schemas (Postgres) each case empties and builds.

reset.description: The target held what the history names, and was emptied first (--reset).

files.description: The test files, relative to the project directory.

status.description: passed: every expectation held. failed: one did not. error: the case could not run (a migration or seed statement failed, an unknown migration id).

failures.description: The expectations that did not hold, one line each.

before.description: The migrations replayed before the seed.

after.description: The migrations run after the seed, with their steps.
